# LoyStudioLab UI 0.1.1

> Component library for LoyStudioLab's own sites and Lab products (Snapticket, Kine OS). React + Tailwind 3.4 + shadcn/ui (JSX), distributed as a shadcn registry. Not for client brands.

Before building UI: read the intents and rules, pick a template, then sections, then components. Install from the registry, put copy in src/data/content.js, run lsl-doctor.

- Registry: https://loystudiolab.github.io/loystudiolab-ui/r/{name}.json  (components.json: "registries": { "@lsl": "https://loystudiolab.github.io/loystudiolab-ui/r/{name}.json" })
- Manifest (full): https://loystudiolab.github.io/loystudiolab-ui/manifest.json
- Manifest (index): https://loystudiolab.github.io/loystudiolab-ui/manifest.index.json
- Full text: https://loystudiolab.github.io/loystudiolab-ui/llms-full.txt

## Intents
- Start a new app or add the library to an existing one: @lsl/foundation, @lsl/doctor, @lsl/accent-budget
- Page frame with header, footer, skip link: SiteShell, SiteHeader, SiteFooter
- A page band / section: Section (surface paper | alt | ink)
- Numbered section heading (01 What we do): TitleBlock + Heading
- Hero title and intro: Eyebrow, Display, Lead, Rise
- The single most important call to action on the page: Button variant="accent" (once per page)
- Any other action: Button (default | outline | ghost), IconButton
- Inline link in text: TextLink
- Parallel items (services, values, steps): RuledGrid + RuledCell, TopRuleCard
- A self-contained item (a case, a person): Card
- Mark work as Studio or Lab, people as Loy: LayerTag, Glyph
- Explain the three marks: LayerLegend, AssemblingMark
- Founder avatar: FounderMonogram
- Person avatar in a product: Avatar (square)
- Facts about a project (client, year, status): MetaList
- A workflow status: StatusBadge
- A category tag: Badge
- A form field: Field + Input | Textarea | Select
- Choose one of 2 to 4 options with hints: RadioTiles
- Choose one of 5+ options: Select
- Yes/no or opt-in: Checkbox, Switch (applies immediately)
- Form error / success: FieldError (via Field), FormAlert, FormSuccess
- Stop form spam: Honeypot
- Inline note or warning in content: Callout
- Transient confirmation: Toaster + toast()
- Loading: Skeleton (known shape), LinearLoader (progress or long wait)
- Nothing to show yet / failed to load / 404: EmptyState, ErrorState, NotFound
- Status icon: StatusIcon
- Side panel or mobile menu: Sheet
- Hint on an icon: Tooltip
- Breadcrumb trail: Breadcrumbs
- Scroll-in motion: Reveal
- Money and dates: formatNOK, formatDate
- In-page section links: useGoToSection, useActiveSection

## Rules
- C1 One accent (butter) CTA per page, maximum.
- C2 Butter is never a surface. Allowed only for: the accent CTA, the Studio glyph/square in the mark, hover underlines, focus rings, text selection.
- C3 Petrol marks the Loy layer only (founder monograms, Loy tags).
- C4 Signal teal only where something is computing or AI-generated. Never decoration.
- C5 Text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1). Concrete, butter, ochre and signal are never text on paper. Use ink-2 for secondary text, brick-deep for errors on paper-alt, signal-ink for Signal text.
- C6 No raw hex or arbitrary color classes in app code. Tokens only.
- S1 Solid circle = Loy, solid square = Studio, hollow triangle = Lab. These shapes mean nothing else.
- S2 No circular or triangular UI chrome: square avatars (except founders), square radios, linear loaders instead of ring spinners, no pie or donut charts.
- S3 Status icons are square-framed (StatusIcon). Never lucide CircleCheck, AlertTriangle, Info or XCircle.
- G1 Radius 0 everywhere.
- G2 Meaningful boundaries are 2px ink (or the surface's line color). The rule color #D8D2C2 is for decorative inner dividers only.
- G3 No shadows. Overlays use a 2px border and an ink scrim.
- G4 No gradients (including skeleton shimmer).
- G5 Base-8 spacing. Use Stack/Cluster/Grid gap steps; half-steps (4px, 12px) only in tight UI.
- T1 Jost for display and headings, Archivo for body and UI. No other families.
- T2 Heading levels are semantic and sequential (one h1, no skips). Visual size is a separate prop.
- T3 Fonts load via <link> in index.html with preconnect, never CSS @import.
- T4 Use the fluid type scale (display, h1, h2, h3, lead, body, small, eyebrow, label). No ad-hoc font sizes for headings.
- A1 AA contrast for all text and UI boundaries.
- A2 Visible focus: butter ring hugging the element plus an ink (or paper) outline. Never remove focus styles.
- A3 Everything works with a keyboard; icon-only controls have labels.
- A4 Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
- A5 Every control has a visible label; errors are linked with aria-describedby; focus moves to the first invalid field, the error alert or the success heading.
- A6 Skip link, landmarks (header, main, footer, nav labels) and a unique document title on every page.
- A7 Touch targets at least 44px.
- A8 Every image has alt text; alt="" only when purely decorative.
- M1 Motion explains (assembly, state change, reveal). It never decorates or loops, except the Signal computing indicator.
- M2 CSS only, durations 150/250/550ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1). No framer-motion.
- M3 Reveals are fail-safe: content is visible unless an IntersectionObserver has proven it runs.
- W1 All UI copy in English.
- W2 No em dashes. Use periods, commas or colons.
- W3 No superlatives or hype (best, leading, revolutionary, cutting-edge, seamless, world-class, game-changing).
- W4 No stats as flex, no invented numbers.
- W5 Real assets over recreations: real screenshots, real quotes, real clients only.
- W6 Copy lives in a data file (src/data/content.js), not inside components.

## Items
### foundation
- @lsl/foundation (lsl-preset.cjs, colors, surfaces, type, motion, fontLink): Tokens, global base styles, surfaces, focus ring, type classes and motion for every LoyStudioLab app. Install first.
- @lsl/doctor (lsl-doctor.mjs): Checks an app against the LoyStudioLab rules and reports violations by rule ID. Run it before you finish any UI task.
- @lsl/accent-budget (AccentBudget): Dev-only console warning when a page renders more than one accent (butter) CTA.

### actions
- @lsl/button (Button): Trigger an action, or style a link as a button with asChild.
- @lsl/icon-button (IconButton, ButtonGroup): An icon-only button with a required accessible label, and a row of buttons.

### forms
- @lsl/input (Input): Single-line text entry. Always inside a Field.
- @lsl/textarea (Textarea): Multi-line text entry. Always inside a Field; pass maxLength and count to Field for a counter.
- @lsl/label (Label): Uppercase UI label for a control. Field renders it for you.
- @lsl/select (Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectGroup, SelectLabel, SelectSeparator): Choose one option from a list of five or more.
- @lsl/checkbox (Checkbox): A yes or no choice, or several independent choices.
- @lsl/radio-group (RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem): One choice from a short list, as square radios (circles mean Loy, rule S2).
- @lsl/switch (Switch): Turn a setting on or off, applied immediately.
- @lsl/field (Field, FieldError, FormAlert, FormSuccess, Honeypot): Wires label, hint, error and character count to a control, plus form-level error, success and anti-bot pieces.
- @lsl/radio-tiles (RadioTiles): Two to four options drawn as ruled tiles with a hint each. The selected tile inverts to ink.

### data-display
- @lsl/badge (Badge): A short uppercase tag: category, count, state.
- @lsl/card (Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter): A flat 2px-ruled container for one item: a case, a person, a setting group.
- @lsl/data-display (TopRuleCard, MetaList, StatusBadge, Avatar): Small display patterns: parallel items with a top rule, term/detail lists, workflow status, square avatars.

### overlays
- @lsl/sheet (Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetDescription, SheetFooter, SheetClose): A panel that slides in from an edge: mobile menu, filters, details.
- @lsl/tooltip (TooltipProvider, Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent): A short hint on hover or focus for an icon or abbreviation.

### layout
- @lsl/separator (Separator): A 2px rule between regions.
- @lsl/layout (Container, Section, Stack, Cluster, Grid, RuledGrid, RuledCell, TitleBlock, Divider): Page bands with surfaces, base-8 spacing stacks, responsive grids and the exposed ruled grid.

### feedback
- @lsl/sonner (Toaster): Short, transient confirmation messages (toast). Mount <Toaster /> once.
- @lsl/skeleton (Skeleton): Placeholder block while content loads. Pulses opacity, no shimmer.
- @lsl/status-icon (StatusIcon): Square-framed status marks: info, success, warning, error, pending.
- @lsl/feedback (Callout, LinearLoader, EmptyState, ErrorState, NotFound): Inline messages, progress, and the empty, error and not-found states.

### brand
- @lsl/mark (Mark, AssemblingMark, Logo, MARK_GEOMETRY): The LoyStudioLab mark and wordmark lockups. INTERIM geometry until the final logo is delivered.
- @lsl/glyph (Glyph, LayerTag, LayerLegend, FounderMonogram, LAYERS): The three layer marks (Loy circle, Studio square, Lab hollow triangle) and the tags, legend and founder monogram built from them.

### typography
- @lsl/typography (Heading, Display, Eyebrow, Lead, Text, TextLink): The type scale as components. Heading level (semantics) and size (looks) are separate.

### navigation
- @lsl/site-header (SiteHeader): Sticky site header: logo, section or page links with the butter active underline, a plain CTA, and a full-height mobile menu.
- @lsl/site-footer (SiteFooter): Footer on paper-alt with logo, tagline, email, site links and the marks legend. Needs react-router (inside <BrowserRouter>).
- @lsl/site-shell (SiteShell, SkipLink): Page frame with landmarks: skip link, header, <main id="main">, footer.
- @lsl/breadcrumbs (Breadcrumbs, NavLink): Where-am-I trail for nested pages, and a standalone nav link with the butter active underline. Needs react-router.

### motion
- @lsl/reveal (Reveal, Rise): The two motion primitives: a fail-safe scroll reveal and a one-time hero entrance. CSS only.

### hooks
- @lsl/section-nav (useGoToSection, useActiveSection): In-page navigation: smooth jump that moves focus to the section heading, and active-section tracking for the header.
- @lsl/use-document-title (useDocumentTitle): Sets the browser title as "Page · LoyStudioLab".
- @lsl/use-reduced-motion (useReducedMotion): True when the user asked for reduced motion; updates live.
- @lsl/field-context (FieldContext, useFieldContext): Lets Field pass its id and aria wiring to controls nested deeper than its direct child (SelectTrigger).
- @lsl/format (formatNOK, formatNumber, formatDate): Money, number and date formatting: English copy, Norwegian conventions (2 500 kr, 1 234,5, 11.11.2026).


## Item details

### @lsl/foundation · Foundation
Tokens, global base styles, surfaces, focus ring, type classes and motion for every LoyStudioLab app. Install first.
Layer L0 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/foundation
Files: src/styles/lsl-preset.cjs, src/lib/lsl-tokens.js, ~/tailwind.config.cjs
- lsl-preset.cjs
- colors, surfaces, type, motion, fontLink
Use when: Always, once per app, before any other @lsl item.
Do not use when: Client brands (OSF HUB, Casa Clean) (use Their own UI. This library is LoyStudioLab-only.)
Rules: G1, G3, G4, A2, A4, T1, T3, C5
Accessibility: Dual focus ring on every focusable element: butter ring plus ink (or paper) outline. All animation and transition collapses under prefers-reduced-motion.
Setup:
- tailwind.config.cjs is replaced by a 6-line config that loads the preset (pass --overwrite). Re-add any app-specific theme.extend entries.
- Add the font <link> from `fontLink` to index.html <head> with preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com (rule T3). Remove any CSS @import of fonts.
- Keep src/index.css to the three @tailwind directives; delete the stock shadcn :root and .dark variable blocks (the preset defines them).
- Wrap page bands in a surface: <Section surface="paper|alt|ink"> or className="surface-ink".
Example:
```jsx
// tailwind.config.cjs
module.exports = {
  presets: [require("./src/styles/lsl-preset.cjs")],
  content: ["./index.html", "./src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}"],
}
```

### @lsl/doctor · lsl-doctor
Checks an app against the LoyStudioLab rules and reports violations by rule ID. Run it before you finish any UI task.
Layer L0 · beta · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/doctor
Files: ~/scripts/lsl-doctor.mjs
- lsl-doctor.mjs
Use when: After building or changing UI in any app that uses the library. In CI for apps that use the library.

Rules: C1, C2, C4, C6, G1, G3, G4, S2, S3, T1, T2, T3, M2, W2, W3, A8
Accessibility: Static checks only. Still run axe and a keyboard pass.

Example:
```jsx
node scripts/lsl-doctor.mjs src            # human-readable
node scripts/lsl-doctor.mjs src --json     # for agents
```

### @lsl/accent-budget · AccentBudget
Dev-only console warning when a page renders more than one accent (butter) CTA.
Layer L0 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/accent-budget
Files: src/components/lsl/dev/accent-budget.jsx
- AccentBudget
    - max: number = 1. Allowed accent CTAs per page.
Use when: Mount once near the app root, next to the router.

Rules: C1


Example:
```jsx
<AccentBudget />
```

### @lsl/button · Button
Trigger an action, or style a link as a button with asChild.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/button
Files: src/components/ui/button.jsx
- Button
    - variant: 'default' | 'accent' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'link' | 'destructive' = default. accent = the page's one highest-priority CTA (C1). default = solid, follows the surface. outline = secondary. ghost = tertiary. destructive = delete or remove.
    - size: 'default' | 'sm' | 'lg' | 'icon' = default. All sizes are at least 44px tall (A7).
    - asChild: boolean = false. Render the child (e.g. a router <Link>) with button styles.
Use when: Any action: submit, open, save, start. Primary page CTA: variant="accent", once per page. A link that should look like a button: asChild around <Link>.
Do not use when: Inline link inside text (use TextLink); Icon-only control (use IconButton); A second accent on the same page (use variant default or outline)
Rules: C1, C2, A2, A7, W1
Accessibility: Busy state: set disabled and aria-busy while sending. Label is the visible text; keep it a verb phrase ("Send message").

Example:
```jsx
<Button variant="accent" size="lg">Send message</Button>
<Button variant="outline">See the work</Button>
<Button asChild><Link to="/contact">Contact</Link></Button>
```

### @lsl/input · Input
Single-line text entry. Always inside a Field.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/input
Files: src/components/ui/input.jsx
- Input
    - type: string = text. Native input type. Use type, inputMode and autoComplete for good mobile keyboards.
Use when: Names, emails, short answers.
Do not use when: More than one line (use Textarea); Choosing from a list (use Select or RadioTiles)
Rules: A5, G2
Accessibility: Wrap in Field so label, hint and error are wired. aria-invalid turns the border to the danger color.

Example:
```jsx
<Field label="Email" required error={errors.email?.message}>
  <Input type="email" autoComplete="email" {...register("email")} />
</Field>
```

### @lsl/textarea · Textarea
Multi-line text entry. Always inside a Field; pass maxLength and count to Field for a counter.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/textarea
Files: src/components/ui/textarea.jsx
- Textarea
Use when: Messages, descriptions, notes.
Do not use when: One line (use Input)
Rules: A5
Accessibility: Field links the character count with aria-describedby.

Example:
```jsx
<Field label="Message" required maxLength={2000} count={message.length}>
  <Textarea rows={6} {...register("message")} />
</Field>
```

### @lsl/label · Label
Uppercase UI label for a control. Field renders it for you.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/label
Files: src/components/ui/label.jsx
- Label
Use when: Only when building a control outside Field.
Do not use when: Normal form fields (use Field)
Rules: A5, T1
Accessibility: Always set htmlFor.

Example:
```jsx
<Label htmlFor="q">Search</Label>
```

### @lsl/select · Select
Choose one option from a list of five or more.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/select
Files: src/components/ui/select.jsx
- Select
- SelectTrigger
- SelectValue
- SelectContent
    - position: 'popper' | 'item-aligned' = popper. Radix positioning mode.
- SelectItem
- SelectGroup
- SelectLabel
- SelectSeparator
Use when: Five or more options, or options that do not need explanation.
Do not use when: Two to four options with hints (use RadioTiles)
Rules: A3, A5, G3
Accessibility: Wrap <Select> in Field: SelectTrigger reads the Field's id and aria wiring through FieldContext, so the label and errors apply.

Example:
```jsx
<Field label="Topic">
  <Select onValueChange={setTopic}>
    <SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder="Choose a topic" /></SelectTrigger>
    <SelectContent>
      <SelectItem value="web">Website</SelectItem>
      <SelectItem value="app">App or internal tool</SelectItem>
    </SelectContent>
  </Select>
</Field>
```

### @lsl/checkbox · Checkbox
A yes or no choice, or several independent choices.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/checkbox
Files: src/components/ui/checkbox.jsx
- Checkbox
Use when: Consent, opt-ins, multi-select lists.
Do not use when: A setting that applies immediately (use Switch)
Rules: S2, A5
Accessibility: Pair with a <Label htmlFor> next to it; the label is the click target.

Example:
```jsx
<div className="flex items-center gap-3">
  <Checkbox id="news" />
  <Label htmlFor="news" className="normal-case tracking-normal text-base font-normal">Send me the occasional update</Label>
</div>
```

### @lsl/radio-group · RadioGroup
One choice from a short list, as square radios (circles mean Loy, rule S2).
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/radio-group
Files: src/components/ui/radio-group.jsx
- RadioGroup
- RadioGroupItem
Use when: Compact one-of-many choice in dense forms.
Do not use when: Two to four options that need hints (use RadioTiles)
Rules: S2, A5
Accessibility: Give the group aria-labelledby pointing at a visible legend.

Example:
```jsx
<RadioGroup defaultValue="email" aria-label="Reply by">
  <div className="flex items-center gap-3"><RadioGroupItem value="email" id="r1" /><Label htmlFor="r1">Email</Label></div>
  <div className="flex items-center gap-3"><RadioGroupItem value="phone" id="r2" /><Label htmlFor="r2">Phone</Label></div>
</RadioGroup>
```

### @lsl/switch · Switch
Turn a setting on or off, applied immediately.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/switch
Files: src/components/ui/switch.jsx
- Switch
Use when: Settings that take effect at once.
Do not use when: A choice submitted with a form (use Checkbox)
Rules: G1, A5
Accessibility: Needs a label via <Label htmlFor> or aria-label.

Example:
```jsx
<div className="flex items-center gap-3"><Switch id="notify" /><Label htmlFor="notify">Notifications</Label></div>
```

### @lsl/badge · Badge
A short uppercase tag: category, count, state.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/badge
Files: src/components/ui/badge.jsx
- Badge
    - variant: 'default' | 'solid' | 'danger' | 'signal' = default. signal is only for AI or computing states (C4).
Use when: Categories, short states, counts.
Do not use when: Loy / Studio / Lab (use LayerTag); A workflow status (use StatusBadge)
Rules: C4, S1
Accessibility: Text must carry the meaning; color is never the only cue.

Example:
```jsx
<Badge>Case study</Badge> <Badge variant="solid">New</Badge>
```

### @lsl/card · Card
A flat 2px-ruled container for one item: a case, a person, a setting group.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/card
Files: src/components/ui/card.jsx
- Card
- CardHeader
- CardTitle
    - as: 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4' = h3. Heading level; keep levels sequential (T2).
- CardDescription
- CardContent
- CardFooter
Use when: Separate, clickable or self-contained items.
Do not use when: A set of parallel items in one block (use RuledGrid (shared rules) or TopRuleCard)
Rules: G1, G2, G3, T2
Accessibility: If the whole card is a link, put the <a> on the title and stretch it (after:absolute after:inset-0).

Example:
```jsx
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Oslo Skatehall</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>An operations system for a community-run skatepark.</CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
</Card>
```

### @lsl/sheet · Sheet
A panel that slides in from an edge: mobile menu, filters, details.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/sheet
Files: src/components/ui/sheet.jsx
- Sheet
- SheetTrigger
- SheetContent
    - side: 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left' = right
    - closeLabel: string = Close. Accessible name of the close button.
- SheetHeader
- SheetTitle
- SheetDescription
- SheetFooter
- SheetClose
Use when: Mobile navigation (SiteHeader uses it). Secondary panels that keep the page visible behind them.
Do not use when: A blocking question (use AlertDialog (phase 3))
Rules: G3, A3
Accessibility: Always render a SheetTitle (visually hidden is fine). Focus is trapped and Escape closes.

Example:
```jsx
<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger asChild><Button variant="outline">Filters</Button></SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent side="right">
    <SheetHeader><SheetTitle>Filters</SheetTitle></SheetHeader>
  </SheetContent>
</Sheet>
```

### @lsl/separator · Separator
A 2px rule between regions.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/separator
Files: src/components/ui/separator.jsx
- Separator
    - orientation: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' = horizontal
    - decorative: boolean = true
    - tone: 'strong' | 'subtle' = strong. subtle is decoration only (G2).
Use when: Between groups in a panel or list.
Do not use when: Between page bands (use Section (has its own top border))
Rules: G2


Example:
```jsx
<Separator />
```

### @lsl/sonner · Toaster
Short, transient confirmation messages (toast). Mount <Toaster /> once.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/sonner
Files: src/components/ui/sonner.jsx
- Toaster
Use when: Confirming a background action: saved, copied, sent.
Do not use when: Errors the user must fix (use FieldError or FormAlert); Persistent information (use Callout)
Rules: S3, G3
Accessibility: Toasts disappear: never put the only copy of important information in one.

Example:
```jsx
import { toast } from "sonner"
<Toaster />
toast.success("Saved")
```

### @lsl/skeleton · Skeleton
Placeholder block while content loads. Pulses opacity, no shimmer.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/skeleton
Files: src/components/ui/skeleton.jsx
- Skeleton
Use when: Content with a known shape that loads in under a few seconds.
Do not use when: Long or unknown waits (use LinearLoader with a label)
Rules: G4, A4
Accessibility: Hidden from screen readers; announce loading elsewhere (aria-busy on the region).

Example:
```jsx
<Skeleton className="h-6 w-40" />
```

### @lsl/tooltip · Tooltip
A short hint on hover or focus for an icon or abbreviation.
Layer L1 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/tooltip
Files: src/components/ui/tooltip.jsx
- TooltipProvider
- Tooltip
- TooltipTrigger
- TooltipContent
    - sideOffset: number = 6
Use when: Naming an icon-only control (in addition to its aria-label).
Do not use when: Information people need to finish a task (use Field hint or Callout)
Rules: A3
Accessibility: Not reachable on touch: never the only place for important text.

Example:
```jsx
<TooltipProvider><Tooltip><TooltipTrigger asChild><IconButton label="Copy link"><Copy /></IconButton></TooltipTrigger><TooltipContent>Copy link</TooltipContent></Tooltip></TooltipProvider>
```

### @lsl/mark · Mark, AssemblingMark, Logo
The LoyStudioLab mark and wordmark lockups. INTERIM geometry until the final logo is delivered.
Layer L2 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/mark
Files: src/components/lsl/brand/mark.jsx
- Mark
    - size: number = 40. Pixel size.
    - title: string. Accessible name; omit when decorative (e.g. next to the wordmark).
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- AssemblingMark
    - focus: 'loy' | 'studio' | 'lab' | null = null. Dims the other two shapes, for a legend that points at one layer.
    - className: string. Set the width here: w-40 sm:w-56 lg:w-72 in a hero; it scales from its viewBox.
- Logo
    - variant: 'horizontal' | 'stacked' | 'mark' = horizontal. horizontal for headers and footers; stacked LOY/STUDIO/LAB for covers; mark alone for tight spaces.
    - size: number. Mark size override.
    - title: string = LoyStudioLab. Accessible name when variant is mark.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- MARK_GEOMETRY
Use when: Site header and footer (Logo). Hero diagrams explaining the name (AssemblingMark). Favicons and covers (Mark, Logo stacked).
Do not use when: Decorating a section (use Nothing. The mark is a signature, not an ornament (M1).); Redrawing the shapes by hand (use Glyph or MARK_GEOMETRY)
Rules: S1, C2, W5
Accessibility: Logo inside a link: give the link aria-label="LoyStudioLab, home".

Example:
```jsx
<Logo />
<Logo variant="stacked" />
<AssemblingMark focus={hovered} className="w-64" />
```

### @lsl/glyph · Glyph, LayerTag, LayerLegend, FounderMonogram
The three layer marks (Loy circle, Studio square, Lab hollow triangle) and the tags, legend and founder monogram built from them.
Layer L2 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/glyph
Files: src/components/lsl/brand/glyph.jsx
- Glyph
    - layer (required): 'loy' | 'studio' | 'lab'. Which layer.
    - size: number = 14
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- LayerTag
    - layer (required): 'loy' | 'studio' | 'lab'
    - children: node = layer name. Label, e.g. "Studio · Website".
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- LayerLegend
    - layers: object = LAYERS. Override copy per layer. LAYERS is canonical brand copy and the one allowed exception to W6; pass content.js copy here when a page explains the layers in its own words.
    - detail: 'short' | 'line' = short. Short label or full sentence. A compact key: for a full section explaining the layers, compose Glyph + Heading in RuledCells instead.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- FounderMonogram
    - initials (required): string
    - name: string. Accessible name; omit when the name is printed next to it.
    - size: number = 56
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- LAYERS
Use when: Tagging work as Studio or Lab, people as Loy. Explaining the three marks (footer, menu, about page). Founder avatars.
Do not use when: Any other meaning (steps, features, Props/People/Process) (use Numbers or words, never shapes (S1)); Avatars for anyone who is not a founder (use Avatar (square)); Generic category tags (use Badge)
Rules: S1, S2, C3
Accessibility: Glyphs are decorative; the layer name is always printed next to them.

Example:
```jsx
// work: "<Layer> · <kind>"; people: layer="loy", label "Loy · Founder"
<LayerTag layer="studio">Studio · Website</LayerTag>
<LayerTag layer="loy">Loy · Founder</LayerTag>
<LayerTag layer="lab" />
<FounderMonogram initials="ML" />
```

### @lsl/layout · Layout: Container, Section, Stack, Cluster, Grid, RuledGrid, TitleBlock, Divider
Page bands with surfaces, base-8 spacing stacks, responsive grids and the exposed ruled grid.
Layer L2 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/layout
Files: src/components/lsl/layout/layout.jsx
- Container
    - as: element type = varies. Rendered element.
    - width: 'site' | 'prose' = site. 1280px column or a ~65ch reading column.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- Section
    - as: element type = varies. Rendered element.
    - surface: 'paper' | 'alt' | 'ink' = paper. Sets colors for everything inside. Alternate paper and alt; use ink for one emphasis band (e.g. the closing CTA).
    - space: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = md. Vertical padding.
    - bordered: boolean = true. 2px ink rule on top.
    - contained: boolean = true. Wrap children in container-site.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- Stack
    - as: element type = varies. Rendered element.
    - gap: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 6 | 8 = 3. Grid steps: 1 = 8px … 8 = 64px.
    - align: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'baseline' | 'stretch' = stretch
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- Cluster
    - as: element type = varies. Rendered element.
    - gap: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 6 | 8 = 2
    - align: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'baseline' | 'stretch' = center
    - justify: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'between' = start
    - wrap: boolean = true
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- Grid
    - as: element type = varies. Rendered element.
    - cols: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 6 | 12 = 3. Columns at full width; collapses on small screens.
    - gap: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 6 | 8 = 4
    - align: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'baseline' | 'stretch' = stretch. Vertical alignment of cells.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- RuledGrid
    - as: element type = varies. Rendered element.
    - cols: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 6 | 12 = 3
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- RuledCell
    - as: element type = varies. Rendered element.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- TitleBlock
    - index: string | number. Section number, e.g. "01".
    - label: string. Section label (eyebrow).
    - children: node. Heading, lead, content.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- Divider
    - tone: 'strong' | 'subtle' = strong
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
Use when: Every page: Sections stacked, each with a surface. Parallel items that belong together: RuledGrid + RuledCell. Numbered page sections: TitleBlock.
Do not use when: Arbitrary margins and paddings (use Stack / Cluster gaps on the base-8 scale (G5))
Rules: G2, G5, C2
Accessibility: Section renders <section>; give it aria-labelledby pointing at its heading id.

Example:
```jsx
<Section surface="alt" aria-labelledby="work-h">
  <TitleBlock index="03" label="Work">
    <Heading level={2} id="work-h">Projects we can show</Heading>
  </TitleBlock>
  <RuledGrid cols={3} className="mt-12">
    <RuledCell><Heading level={3}>Digitalization</Heading><Text tone="muted">…</Text></RuledCell>
  </RuledGrid>
</Section>
```

### @lsl/typography · Typography: Heading, Display, Eyebrow, Lead, Text, TextLink
The type scale as components. Heading level (semantics) and size (looks) are separate.
Layer L2 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/typography
Files: src/components/lsl/typography/typography.jsx
- Heading
    - level: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 = 2. Semantic level. One h1 per page; never skip levels (T2).
    - size: 'display' | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 = matches level. Visual size.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- Display
    - level: 1 | 2 = 1
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- Eyebrow
    - as: element type = varies. Rendered element.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- Lead
    - as: element type = varies. Rendered element.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- Text
    - as: element type = varies. Rendered element.
    - size: 'body' | 'small' | 'label' = body
    - tone: 'default' | 'muted' | 'danger' = default. muted = ink-2 (passes AA).
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- TextLink
    - asChild: boolean = false. Wrap a router <Link>.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
Use when: All text. Prefer these over raw classes so levels and sizes stay consistent.
Do not use when: Muted gray text in concrete (#A39B8B) (use Text tone="muted" (concrete fails AA, C5))
Rules: T1, T2, T4, C5, W1, W2
Accessibility: Hero title is the page's only h1. A section heading that receives focus from in-page nav needs tabIndex={-1} and data-section-heading.

Example:
```jsx
<Eyebrow>Design and technology studio in Oslo</Eyebrow>
<Display>We design and build the digital tools small organizations run on.</Display>
<Lead>We help community organizations and local businesses …</Lead>
<Text tone="muted">Read the <TextLink href="/work/osf-hub">OSF HUB case</TextLink>.</Text>
```

### @lsl/icon-button · IconButton, ButtonGroup
An icon-only button with a required accessible label, and a row of buttons.
Layer L2 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/icon-button
Files: src/components/lsl/actions/icon-button.jsx
- IconButton
    - label (required): string. Accessible name and tooltip.
    - variant: Button variant = outline
- ButtonGroup
    - attached: boolean = false. Join buttons into one ruled bar.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
Use when: Toolbar actions, menu toggles, close buttons. Primary + secondary action pairs (ButtonGroup).
Do not use when: An action people need to discover (use Button with a text label)
Rules: A3, A7, S3
Accessibility: Lucide icons inside must have aria-hidden="true".

Example:
```jsx
<IconButton label="Open menu"><Menu aria-hidden="true" /></IconButton>
<ButtonGroup><Button variant="accent">Start a project</Button><Button variant="outline">See the work</Button></ButtonGroup>
```

### @lsl/field · Field, FieldError, FormAlert, FormSuccess, Honeypot
Wires label, hint, error and character count to a control, plus form-level error, success and anti-bot pieces.
Layer L2 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/field
Files: src/components/lsl/forms/field.jsx
- Field
    - label (required): node. Visible label.
    - hint: node. Help text under the label.
    - error: string. Error message; sets aria-invalid.
    - required: boolean = false. Adds * and aria-required.
    - optional: boolean = false. Adds "(optional)".
    - id: string = auto
    - count: number. Current length, for the counter.
    - maxLength: number. Shows a counter.
    - children (required): element. Exactly one control: Input, Textarea or SelectTrigger wrapper.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- FieldError
    - id: string
    - message: string
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- FormAlert
    - tone: 'error' | 'success' | 'info' = error
    - title: node
    - children: node
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- FormSuccess
    - title (required): node. Focused on mount.
    - children: node
    - action: node. E.g. "Send another message".
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- Honeypot
    - name: string = website. Field name; spread register(name) on it.
Use when: Every form control. Form-level errors (FormAlert) and success (FormSuccess).
Do not use when: Bare Input with a placeholder as the label (use Field with a visible label (A5))
Rules: A5, S3, W1, W3
Accessibility: On submit errors, focus the first invalid field (react-hook-form shouldFocusError does this). On server errors, focus the FormAlert. Keep the user's text. Error copy says what to do: "Please add your email, so we can reply."

Example:
```jsx
<form noValidate onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="flex flex-col gap-7">
  {failed && <FormAlert ref={alertRef} title="Your message was not sent.">Your text is still here. Try again, or email us.</FormAlert>}
  <Field label="Name" required error={errors.name?.message}>
    <Input autoComplete="name" {...register("name")} />
  </Field>
  <Honeypot {...register("website")} />
</form>
```

### @lsl/radio-tiles · RadioTiles
Two to four options drawn as ruled tiles with a hint each. The selected tile inverts to ink.
Layer L2 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/radio-tiles
Files: src/components/lsl/forms/radio-tiles.jsx
- RadioTiles
    - legend (required): node. Question shown above the tiles.
    - options (required): { value, label?, hint? }[]
    - value: string. Controlled value.
    - onValueChange: (value) => void
    - onBlur: () => void
    - error: string
    - required: boolean = false
    - name: string
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
Use when: "What is this about?" style choices with short explanations.
Do not use when: Five or more options (use Select)
Rules: S2, A5
Accessibility: Arrow keys move between tiles (Radix). With react-hook-form, use a Controller.

Example:
```jsx
<Controller name="reason" control={control} render={({ field }) => (
  <RadioTiles legend="What is this about?" required error={errors.reason?.message}
    value={field.value} onValueChange={field.onChange} onBlur={field.onBlur}
    options={[{ value: "New project", hint: "You have something to build." }, { value: "Collaboration" }, { value: "General question" }]} />
)} />
```

### @lsl/site-header · SiteHeader
Sticky site header: logo, section or page links with the butter active underline, a plain CTA, and a full-height mobile menu.
Layer L3 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/site-header
Files: src/components/lsl/navigation/site-header.jsx
- SiteHeader
    - items: { label, id? , href? }[] = []. id = section on the home page; href = another page.
    - cta: { label, href, id? }. Shown as a default (ink) button. Never accent: the page's accent CTA lives in the content (C1).
    - homePath: string = /
    - showLegend: boolean = true. Show the marks legend in the mobile menu.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
Use when: Every marketing site and case-study page.
Do not use when: Product / app screens (use AppShell (phase 3))
Rules: C1, A3, A6, A7
Accessibility: Active section uses aria-current="location"; active page aria-current="page". Mobile menu traps focus and closes with Escape.
Setup:
- Needs react-router: render inside <BrowserRouter> (Base44 apps already have one in App.jsx).
- For section items ({ id }): put the id on the <Section>, and give that section's heading tabIndex={-1} and data-section-heading so focus lands on it after the jump.
Example:
```jsx
<SiteHeader
  items={[{ id: "what-we-do", label: "What we do" }, { id: "work", label: "Work" }, { id: "about", label: "About" }]}
  cta={{ label: "Contact", href: "/#contact", id: "contact" }}
/>
```

### @lsl/data-display · TopRuleCard, MetaList, StatusBadge, Avatar
Small display patterns: parallel items with a top rule, term/detail lists, workflow status, square avatars.
Layer L2 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/data-display
Files: src/components/lsl/data-display/data-display.jsx
- TopRuleCard
    - title (required): node
    - as: 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4' = h3. Heading element.
    - bar: 'ink' | 'brick' | 'ochre' | 'petrol' | 'concrete' = ink. Rule color. Values cards may use the muted palette; never butter (C2).
    - children: node
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- MetaList
    - items (required): { term, detail }[]
    - cols: 1 | 2 | 3 = 2
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- StatusBadge
    - status: 'draft' | 'active' | 'done' | 'paused' | 'error' | 'ai' = draft. ai is only for AI-generated content (C4).
    - children: node = status label. Override the label.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- Avatar
    - src: string
    - name: string. Alt text and initials source.
    - initials: string
    - size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = md
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
Use when: Services or values in a row (TopRuleCard). Case facts (MetaList). Lists of things with a state (StatusBadge). People in products (Avatar).
Do not use when: Founders (use FounderMonogram); Loy / Studio / Lab (use LayerTag)
Rules: S2, S3, C2, C4
Accessibility: StatusBadge always shows text; the icon is decorative.

Example:
```jsx
<TopRuleCard title="Digitalization">One real system instead of spreadsheets, chat threads and paper.</TopRuleCard>
<MetaList items={[{ term: "Client", detail: "Oslo Skateboardforening" }, { term: "Status", detail: "In use" }]} />
<StatusBadge status="done" />
```

### @lsl/feedback · Callout, LinearLoader, EmptyState, ErrorState, NotFound
Inline messages, progress, and the empty, error and not-found states.
Layer L2 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/feedback
Files: src/components/lsl/feedback/feedback.jsx
- Callout
    - tone: 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' = info
    - title: node
    - children: node
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- LinearLoader
    - value: number (0-100). Omit for indeterminate.
    - label: string = Loading. Accessible name.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- EmptyState
    - title: node = Nothing here yet
    - children: node. What this area is for and how to fill it.
    - action: node. Usually a Button.
    - headingLevel: number = 2
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- ErrorState
    - title: node = Something went wrong
    - children: node = It is on our side. Please try again.
    - action: node. Retry button.
    - headingLevel: number = 2
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- NotFound
    - title: node = This page does not exist
    - children: node = The link may be old, or the address has a typo.
    - action: node
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
Use when: Persistent notes in content (Callout). Uploads and long loads (LinearLoader). First use and no-results (EmptyState); failed loads (ErrorState); 404 routes (NotFound).
Do not use when: A ring spinner (use LinearLoader (S2)); Transient confirmations (use Toaster)
Rules: S2, S3, A4, W1, W3
Accessibility: ErrorState has role="alert". LinearLoader is a labelled progressbar.

Example:
```jsx
<Callout tone="warning" title="Prices exclude VAT">We add 25% MVA on the invoice.</Callout>
<LinearLoader value={60} label="Uploading receipt" />
<EmptyState title="No receipts yet" action={<Button>Add a receipt</Button>}>Photos of receipts you add will show up here.</EmptyState>
```

### @lsl/reveal · Reveal, Rise
The two motion primitives: a fail-safe scroll reveal and a one-time hero entrance. CSS only.
Layer L2 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/reveal
Files: src/components/lsl/motion/reveal.jsx
- Reveal
    - as: element type = varies. Rendered element.
    - delay: number (s) = 0. Stagger siblings by 0.06 to 0.1s.
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
- Rise
    - as: element type = varies. Rendered element.
    - delay: number (s) = 0
    - className: string. Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.
Use when: Section content as it scrolls in (Reveal). Hero text on load (Rise).
Do not use when: Looping or decorative motion (use Nothing (M1)); framer-motion (use These CSS primitives (M2))
Rules: M1, M2, M3, A4
Accessibility: Content stays visible if observers never run; reduced motion shows it at once.

Example:
```jsx
<Reveal><Heading level={2}>How we work</Heading></Reveal>
<Rise delay={0.1}><Lead>…</Lead></Rise>
```

### @lsl/section-nav · useGoToSection, useActiveSection

### @lsl/field-context · FieldContext
Lets Field pass its id and aria wiring to controls nested deeper than its direct child (SelectTrigger).

- FieldContext
- useFieldContext
Use when: Building a new control that should work inside Field without being its direct child.
Do not use when: Normal forms (use Field (it handles this for you))

### @lsl/format · formatNOK, formatNumber, formatDate
Money, number and date formatting: English copy, Norwegian conventions (2 500 kr, 1 234,5, 11.11.2026).
Layer L0 · stable · install: npx shadcn@latest add @lsl/format
Files: src/lib/format.js
- formatNOK
    - amount (required): number
    - options: { decimals?, locale? } = { decimals: 0, locale: 'nb-NO' }
- formatNumber
    - value (required): number
    - options: { decimals?, locale? }
- formatDate
    - value (required): Date | string
    - options: { style?: 'long' | 'short' | 'numeric', locale? } = { style: 'long', locale: 'en-GB' }
Use when: Any amount or date shown to people.
Do not use when: toFixed or manual string building (use These helpers)
Rules: W1


Example:
```jsx
formatNOK(2500) // "2 500 kr"
formatDate("2026-11-11") // "11 November 2026"
```
